observation: Fresh main had hardened browser list fields and settle timing, but scalar assertion fields still silently coerced malformed values: titleIncludes/urlIncludes used String(...||''), while boolean evidence policies treated every value except literal false as true. This allowed explicit malformed validation plans to be rewritten rather than preserved or rejected.
changes: Require explicitly supplied titleIncludes/urlIncludes values to be strings while preserving the existing empty-string default when omitted.
Require explicitly supplied console/page/network/screenshot policy values to be booleans while preserving the existing true default when omitted.
Keep selector/text plans, settle timing, URL validation, CDP execution, and receipt semantics unchanged.
